SELECT s.*,t.tutor_name,u.level_id, levelDef.level_val, levelDef.level_name FROM user_follow_up_request s inner join tutor_info t on s.tutor_id=t.id inner join user_info u on u.id=s.user_id LEFT JOIN level_def levelDef ON u.level_id = levelDef.id
s.user_id=#{param.userId} and
t.tutor_name like '%${param.tutor}%' and
t.domain_type=#{param.domainType} and
s.item_type=#{param.itemType} and
s.status=#{param.status} and
s.request_time >= #{param.timeStart} and
s.request_time <= #{param.timeEnd} and
s.operateTime >= #{param.operateTimeStart} and
s.operateTime <= #{param.operateTimeEnd} and
order by s.id desc

SELECT followRequest.id AS followRequestId, followRequest.request_time, followRequest.amount, followRequest.item_type, followRecord.id AS followRecordId, followRecord.follow_order_sn, followRecord.follow_start_time, followRecord.return_follow_sum, followRecord.tutor_commission, followRecord.platform_commission, tutorInfo.id AS tutorId, tutorInfo.tutor_name FROM user_follow_up_request followRequest LEFT JOIN tutor_info tutorInfo ON followRequest.tutor_id = tutorInfo.id LEFT JOIN user_follow_up_record followRecord ON followRequest.id = followRecord.follow_request_id
followRequest.user_id = #{param.userId} and
followRequest.tutor_id = #{param.tutorId} and
followRequest.`status` = 0 and
followRequest.`status` = 2 and
followRecord.follow_status = 0 and
followRecord.follow_status = 2 and
order by followRequest.request_time desc
